name: HYDRA-UMC-GATEWAY-INDUSTRIAL
notes: Established v0: GET /status makes a real, live reachability check against all 3 children on every request - verified end-to-end, including detecting a real killed sibling. Plus a real command allowlist + backpressure + timeout decision layer (src/command.ts, CommandDispatcher) in front of POST /command: default-deny per-protocol allowlist (only read-like/publish operations allowed in v0), bounded concurrency (no more than maxConcurrent commands in flight, rejected immediately beyond that), and a real timeout - all enforced before any relay attempt, mapped to real HTTP status codes (403/429/504/502). The default executor reuses the existing real reachability probes; an actual protocol-level write is not implemented yet, honestly. 27 tests.
